landing.headline: Pharmaceutical distribution, tracked from batch to delivery.
landing.lede: A pharmacy distributor cannot answer “where is that batch right now?” from a spreadsheet. Bershama is the system that answers it: every batch carries its expiry and its location, every movement is written to an append-only ledger, and short-dated stock raises an alert before it becomes waste.
landing.traceabilityBody: Every batch is WHO GDP-aligned: an expiry, a storage condition and a chain of custody. The ledger records who moved it, when, and why.
landing.expiryBody: A nightly scan — or one on demand — raises alerts on short shelf life and expired stock, before the write-off rather than after.
landing.coldChainBody: Temperature readings are taken at handover and attached to the batch, so the record exists when someone asks about it.
landing.fefoBody: A pharmacy’s request is filled from the batches that expire soonest, and the quantity is locked while the decision is made.
landing.deliveryBody: Trips, stops and proof of delivery, with position reported as the run proceeds and every stop accounted for.
landing.valuationBody: Stock is valued at batch cost, and cover is extrapolated from the last 30 days of issues — a prompt to reorder, not a forecast.
landing.adminRoleBody: The catalogue, stock levels, the alert centre and the full audit trail for your organisation.
landing.pharmacyRoleBody: Request stock, watch it move, and see what is already on its way.
landing.driverRoleBody: The day’s stops, the stock on board, and the signature at the door.
landing.securityRls: Row Level Security on every table, enforced by the database rather than the application
landing.securityAudit: Tenant isolation: another organisation’s rows are invisible even though the tables are shared
landing.securityAppendOnly: An append-only audit trail, immutable by database trigger
landing.securityArabic: English and Arabic, with full right-to-left support throughout
landing.capabilitiesLede: Operational tooling designed around pharmacy cash-flow and warehouse physical shelf life.
landing.railHeading: Active lot repository · Cairo / Giza hub
landing.footerLede: High-integrity pharmaceutical logistics operating across Cairo, Giza and regional delta supply routes.
